scope: Incremental bounded IPC/helper cost against a fixed PUBLIC fake-answer C fixture, not a usable product or secure UI baseline. Both use the same real Rust parent state/private endpoint/serviced stream, test frontend polling, generated encrypted key, OpenSSH/config/server, SFTP codec, 501 entries and 32MiB bidirectional verification, compression/control reuse disabled. Both launchers exec SSH. Two warmups per wait mode then at least five alternating pairs for immediate and 1s answers. Stable wait samples trim 100ms from each end of the observed 3-process overlap. Includes test harness and simulated frontend; excludes GUI/IME/Windows/weak networks/long idle/full-heap proof. Short-lived process peaks may be missed. No user SSH files, agent or credentials.
